source: nflverse/nfldata games.csv + nflverse-data stats_team_week, through the football module in app.html

distributions.basis: the engine’s own residual of projected home margin against the realised margin, and its spread-conditioned margin pmf; fitted on the training seasons and applied unchanged
distributions.limitations: describes the spread of outcomes around THIS model’s projection; it is not a market-implied distribution and the validation tier decides whether it may be read as a betting probability

validation.record: NFL 2016-2025 (hyperparams frozen on <=2015) vs the closing consensus: spread MAE 10.2 against the market's 9.777; ATS 48.7% at 0.5+ points (n=2310, p=0.8941), 48.93% at 1+ points (n=1962, p=0.8285), 48.92% at 1.5+ points (n=1615, p=0.8081), 49.05% at 2+ points (n=1319, p=0.7544), 50.8% at 3+ points (n=870, p=0.3297). No band clears p<0.05; the model does not beat the close.

notes: No captured NFL quotes in this window (offseason, or capture has not priced NFL yet); nflverse reference numbers shown where published are a consensus close, not a bettable price.
